supersedes.what_was_wrong: v2 carried BOTH a 'video only' and a 'with audio' rate for each Veo tier, taken from the Vertex AI pricing page. ONIQ does not use Vertex. On the AI Studio / Gemini API surface it actually uses there is NO video-only tier at all: every Veo row is labelled 'video with audio price (default)' and is a single rate. So $0.03/s Lite and $0.08/s Fast are NOT REACHABLE by ONIQ, and every table built on them understated cost.

fx.note: NOT hard-coded from memory. The repo's storyCostModel.UNIT.inrPerUsd = 84 is 13.9% below this and understates every provider cost denominated in USD. (unchanged in v3)
fx.caveat: A spot rate moves. Any price ladder derived from it must be re-checked before activation, and should carry FX headroom rather than being set at the edge of viability.

entries.note: THE ONLY Lite rate available on ONIQ's surface. Audio is bundled and cannot be declined — generateAudio and six alternate spellings all return HTTP 400.
Standard tier. 8x Lite; not a candidate.
CREDITS_PER_SECOND = 5 in src/lib/runway.server.ts is a credit rate, not a price. Host never reached, credit price never verified, no INR figure invented.

in_house.note: Denominated in INR already, so the FX correction does not move it. This is why the in-house floor is unaffected by the FX and audio findings.

do_not_mix.rule: Three different numbers must never be conflated.
do_not_mix.generated_cost: USD or INR per second the provider bills, whether or not the output is kept.
do_not_mix.accepted_cost: Cost per second ONIQ actually ships, which includes spend on rejected attempts. Always >= generated cost.
do_not_mix.customer_price: GST-inclusive INR the user pays. Set from accepted cost plus margin, never from generated cost.

surface.why_it_matters: Vertex AI publishes separate video-only and with-audio prices. AI Studio does not. ONIQ calls AI Studio, so only the with-audio rate exists for it.
surface.verbatim: Veo 3.1 Lite video with audio price (default) — $0.05 (720p) / $0.08 (1080p); Veo 3.1 Fast video with audio price (default) — $0.10 (720p) / $0.12 (1080p) / $0.30 (4k); Veo 3.1 Standard — $0.40 (720p and 1080p) / $0.60 (4k)

filtered_generations.basis: DOCUMENTED, not reconciled against an invoice.
quotes: You will only be charged if your video is successfully generated. — ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing
You will not be charged if your video is blocked from generating. — ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/veo
filtered_generations.caveat: Both statements sit beside the audio-processing case and neither says 'RAI-filtered output'. The shape matches (done:true, zero samples), but the billing view was not reachable, so the 21-vs-17 generation count for 2026-08-24 was never checked. Economics therefore carry BOTH a lower bound (filtered free) and a conservative bound (filtered billed).
